notes.title: Update (v1.1.1)
notes.content:
This update contains the following changes:

[list]
    [*]Reset button was missing in the UI. It's added and It's located in the menu after you have loaded a slot.
    [*]A puzzle wasn't triggering when game was loaded. This is now fixed.
[/list]

Please let me know if you have any issues with the game and I will try to solve them.

notes.title: Update (v1.1)
notes.content:
This patch contains the following changes.


[h1]Oculus support[/h1]
There is now official Oculus support for Spacescape. Tested by myself on a rift setup. If there are any issues please let me know. 

[h1]Engine update[/h1]
The game has been updated to the latest engine version which help with some issues people where having.

[h1]Windows Mixed Reality[/h1]
It's not officially supported yet since I don't have a headset. But this patch should remove the rotation distrotion issues some people where having. https://steamcommunity.com/app/639560/discussions/0/3211505894118634045/
If there are any issues please let me know.

[h1]New UI[/h1]
A new UI has been added to make it more easy to get started.

[h1]Settings will now be saved[/h1]
I got some reports that settings weren't saved. They should be saved and loaded every time you start the game now.

[h1]Whats next?[/h1]
There is an upcoming patch to add an arcade mode. This is mostly for VR arcades but it adds some smaller levels with the existing puzzles. It doesn't use saves and may be completed within 30-60 minutes.

As always if you have any feedback let me know and I will look into it.
